Author: dajoey
Name: LazyFoodBuff
Description: Auto-eats food in combat duties with per-job selection, auto-select based on best stats, and a low-food warning.
Punchline: Never forget to eat your food again.
Changelog: v0.1.1.0 - Low-food warning + deep dungeons. (1) The alert now triggers on how much food you have left in your bag, not on time remaining on the buff; new 'Warn when food left is at or below' count slider (default 3), alerts once and re-arms after you restock. (2) Auto-eat now works in deep dungeons (Palace of the Dead, Heaven-on-High, Eureka Orthos) — they were wrongly excluded. v0.1.0.0 - Initial release. Use /lazyfoodbuff.
